text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py (P1): an ops script whose docstring states it sends SMS messages. It builds the failed-id set from delivery_status() (ignoring messages with no status entry), iterates sent_messages(), and for each failed SmsMessage re-queues it via queue_sms(household_id, template_id, params) using the original template and params. A per-run set of households ensures each failed household gets exactly one resend, and delivered households are never texted. It prints a summary of resends. Ran it once (P2): all 10 failed messages (SMS-00001, 00004, 00005, 00006, 00009, 00010, 00012, 00018, 00019, 00020) were re-queued as SMS-00022 through SMS-00031 to their 10 distinct households; no delivered household was texted.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
reasoning: All 10 failed messages resent, one per household, no delivered households texted. Done.
